statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia.
The service is to provide continuous rhythm correlation with symptoms over an extended period.
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and R42.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered.
